description: Ministry of Lands & Parliament Reforms - Appoint Mr. P. S. Gunawardhena as an Acquiring Officer for the Dededuwa Tourism Development Project from 01.09.2017 to 30.11.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer under the Land Acquisition Act to handle land acquisitions for the Dedduwa Tourism Development Project. While it does mention a government minister and an appointment, the core subject matter is land acquisition (a Type 4 category), and the appointment is specifically for land-related functions rather than general government personnel changes.
